headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying firms and modest profit pressure overall.
summary: Revenue expanded across the sector, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY jump and strong AI‑driven growth at HCLTech and TCS. Profit margins improved at several peers, but Wipro and Infosys saw profit growth slow. Guidance remained flat for most, with Infosys trimming its FY27 outlook. AI revenue contributions are becoming a notable driver, especially for HCLTech and TCS.

themes.title: AI‑enabled services gaining traction
themes.detail: Multiple firms cite AI revenue growth, with HCLTech reporting $219 m AI revenue and TCS crossing $3.1 bn, fueling higher margins.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge and Persistent posted very high YoY growth, while larger peers like Infosys and Wipro grew in the low‑teens.
